full_name: Lisa Szczepura | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Lisa F. Szczepura, an assistant professor of inorganic chemistry at Illinois State University (ISU), proposes to focus on the development of Mo6S8 cluster cores as building blocks in the preparation of new materials for applications as cathode materials in rechargeable lithium batteries.
